Implementation began on development after the source-only GitHub workspace backup.
Implemented concurrent local-byte and delegated-source routing, tool-requested queued local handoff, Toonverse workspace selection, lifecycle cleanup, and focused regression coverage.
An explicitly blank delegated-target still satisfied Spring ConditionalOnProperty and caused delegatedViewerService to throw during startup.
Replaced the generic property condition with a nonblank delegated-target condition on both the viewer factory and route; focused regression tests passed.

Marked the canonical External record constructor for Spring configuration binding and added a binding regression test; the delegated target now reaches the lifecycle policy.
